question: Which of the following hills are located in Purvachal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Mizo hills and Naga hills**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mizo hills and Naga hills** are part of the Purvachal range, which is a sub-mountain range of the Himalayas in northeastern India.
 
• The Purvachal range runs along the eastern side of India, covering areas in the states of Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, and Tripura.
 
• This range is characterized by a series of hills including the Mizo hills, Naga hills, Patkai hills, and others.
 
• The region is known for its rich biodiversity, unique cultural heritage, and significant strategic importance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Purvachal range is part of the larger Eastern Himalayas, which extend from Bhutan through Arunachal Pradesh, and along the northern border of Myanmar.
 
• The region is also home to many indigenous tribes with distinct languages, cultures, and traditions.
 
• Geologically, the hills are composed mainly of sedimentary rocks, which are subject to significant erosion and weathering.
 
• The area receives heavy rainfall due to the monsoon, contributing to its lush green forests and diverse ecosystems.
